40 weeks + 7 days = 40 × 7 + 7 = 287 days.  
1153 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1153-03-11 add 287 days:  
March: 31 - 11 = 20 days used → 267 left.  
April: 30 → 237 left.  
May: 31 → 206 left.  
June: 30 → 176 left.  
July: 31 → 145 left.  
August: 31 → 114 left.  
September: 30 → 84 left.  
October: 31 → 53 left.  
November: 30 → 23 left.  
December: 31 → -8 means into December: 23 days into December = December 24.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1153-12-24
